videos.title: The Planet Where It Rains Molten Iron!
videos.hook: This planet literally rains boiling metal at night.
videos.fact: On WASP-76b, extreme day heat vaporizes iron. Winds blow it to the freezing night side. Unlike Earth's water rain, this vapor condenses into liquid iron droplets.

videos.title: The Star Colder Than Ice 🥶
videos.hook: There is a star you can touch without getting burned.
videos.fact: Meet WISE 0855, a failed star. Instead of blazing nuclear fire, this cosmic anomaly is actually freezing. Its temperature is way below zero, meaning its atmosphere is filled with water-ice clouds instead of burning gas.

videos.title: Why Your Head Is Older Than Your Feet 🤯
videos.hook: Why does your head age faster than your feet?
videos.fact: Gravity actually warps time. Because your feet are closer to Earth's center, gravity pulls harder on them. This slows down time at your feet, while your head ticks slightly faster in the weaker gravity above.

videos.title: The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b 🌌
videos.hook: This planet is darker than coal, swallowing all light.
videos.fact: Meet TrES-2b. It absorbs ninety-nine percent of light, reflecting almost nothing. It is a pitch-black cosmic mystery.
